title: Feather Bulb Collection from Avian Bird Species for Molecular Diagnostics
author: Naluepanat Yodjan

steps.title: Prepare hands and gloves
steps.instruction: Clean your hands before sampling; wear latex or disposable gloves and change gloves between each bird to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Collect appropriate feather bulbs
steps.instruction: Pluck five to ten feathers that contain cellular material (e.g., pin feathers, primary, secondary, greater coverts, or tail feathers), ensuring each feather includes an intact bulb; do not use shed feathers or feathers cut from the bird.

steps.title: Package and label feathers
steps.instruction: Place the plucked feathers in a clean, sealed plastic bag and clearly label the bag with the avian species, the bird’s name or identification number, and the date of collection.

steps.title: Transport specimens promptly
steps.instruction: Deliver the sealed bag to the laboratory within 2–3 days; specimens may be transported at room temperature, and upon arrival should be stored at 4 °C until molecular testing is performed.

steps.title: Extended storage if needed
steps.instruction: If immediate delivery is not possible, air‑dry the feathers in a clean, contamination‑free area, then place them in a sealed plastic bag and deliver to the laboratory within 2 weeks of collection.
